It uses system APIs such as os.uname, os.getpid, and os.popen to invoke system symbolication tools (atos or xcrun) for translating stack addresses into human-readable symbols, which is a legitimate and common practice in debugging tools. Unlike the known malicious patterns, this code does not perform any obfuscated or encoded command execution, no host fingerprinting or conditional payload deployment, no data exfiltration, and no anti-analysis or evasion techniques.             with open(dest_dir + "output", "wb") as fd:
                fd.write(content[offset:])
